description:
**File**: `src/utils/url_normalizer.cr:106`

**Severity**: P3 (perf, allocation hotspot)

```crystal
private def self.normalize_query(query : String) : String
  ...
  tracking_pattern = Regex.new("#{TRACKING_PARAMS.join("|")}=?(&|$)", Regex::Options::IGNORE_CASE)
  cleaned = cleaned.gsub(tracking_pattern, "")
```

Every URL normalization allocates a new `Regex` object. Should be
a module-level constant alongside the existing `TRACKING_REGEX`
(line 65-68).

**Fix**: Move the `Regex.new` call out of the method and into a
module-level constant.

```crystal
TRACKING_EMPTY_REGEX = Regex.new(
  "(#{TRACKING_PARAMS.join("|")})=?(&|$)",
  Regex::Options::IGNORE_CASE
)
```

This is called per URL on every feed refresh, so the allocation
savings add up over a refresh cycle with 207 feeds.

Found during code review 2026-06-18, see
`planning/code-review-2026-06-18.md` §4.1.
title: URLNormalizer builds Regex per call (allocation hotspot)
